form.heading: Join us on mentoring
form.description: Join us on mentoring as a mentor, volunteer, or guest lecturer — help grow Bitcoin education across Africa. Share your details and we’ll reach out with next steps.
form.success_message: Thank you — welcome aboard. We’ll reach out with next steps.

mentor.title: Mentor
mentor.description: Support students during cohorts, lead Q&A sessions, help review assignments, and provide guidance on Bitcoin, Lightning, or sovereignty.

lecturer.title: Guest Lecturer
lecturer.description: Teach specialized sessions (Lightning, mining, nodes, privacy, etc.), share industry or technical experience, and participate in panel discussions.

volunteer.title: Volunteer
volunteer.description: Help with community moderation, student onboarding, content creation, or administrative tasks. Flexible time commitment.

why_matter.heading: Why mentoring & volunteers matter
why_matter.p1: Bitcoin education grows through community, not classrooms.
why_matter.p2: Our mentors, volunteers, and guest lecturers help shape the next generation of African Bitcoin talent.
why_matter.p3: If you share our mission of sovereignty, freedom, and open knowledge — we invite you to join us.
